## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The release gate change must be fixed before merge: the change to `zzz-release/gate.py` now rejects releases that have exactly the minimum number of approvals.

## Changes
The pull request renames the 1,500 generated catalog entries from `legacy-service-NNNN` (ports 10000–11499) to `production-service-NNNN` (ports 20000–21499) and adds a top-level `review_note` key. It also replaces `len(failures) == 0` with `not failures` in `healthy`, and changes `approved` from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` so exactly `minimum` approvals pass — `approved(2)` with the default `minimum=2` now returns `False` because `approvals > minimum` excludes the boundary, while the module docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1` says "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." The existing tests use only 3 and 1 approvals, so they don't catch this boundary. — A release with exactly the required number of approvals is blocked, and every release now needs one more approval than its policy requires. — Fix: Revert to `approvals >= minimum` and extend `test_approved_release` in `tests/test_release.py` with the `approvals == minimum` case.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
(none)

## Not reviewed
- This review did not read `aaa-generated/catalog.json` diff lines 2234–8979 line by line; it checked them only by pattern counts (1,500 `production-service-NNNN` keys and 1,500 ports matching `2NNNN`), which do not confirm that each key's index matches its port.
- The generator for `aaa-generated/catalog.json` is not in this repository, so this review could not confirm that regenerating the file reproduces the committed content.
